contentPattern: One row per pharmacy, 2 cells: [logo picture with the source alt text] | [paragraph pharmacy name; paragraph with bold website link (absolute URL); paragraph phone number as a tel: link]. Logo cell optional. A tel: link with no digits (source has 'tel:+') is rebuilt from its visible number (e.g. 1-800-347-3416 -> tel:+18003473416); a plain-text phone paragraph is linked. Rendered as a card grid: logo on white over a green details band.
